Name: Even Better Artisan Good Icons for Cornucopia-MoreCrops
Author: PlepArts
Description:
This Mod adds new icons for wines, jellies, Juices, pickles and dried mushrooms added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia-MoreCrops[/url] 

I use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22144]Even Better Artisan Good Icons[/url] Framework.

If you want the custom sprites you need to change the link in the "Data" JSON-file for example

  ﻿ "Honey": "assets/honey.png",
﻿  "Juice": "assets/juice.png",
to
  ﻿ "Honey": "assets/honey_custom.png",
﻿  "Juice": "assets/juice_custom.png",

Originally i made the Icons for my 1.6 playthrough.
It is my first upload still i hope someone appreciates the images. :>>

For Cornucopia-MoreFlowers download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22437]EBAGI C-MF[/url]


Huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/198773339]haze1nuts[/url] for helping me setting this up and making the Framwork Mod
